### Linked issue

No linked issue. A user reported that images sent from a phone were invisible on desktop, and images sent from desktop were invisible on the phone in the same chat.

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Enhancement
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs

### Reasoning

The sending client can preview its locally stored attachment, but canonical submitted messages retain only text. Provider echo reconciliation then consumes the provider message without carrying its images into the canonical row. OMP also drops image blocks from native live events and history, including entire image-only messages. Real Pi QA additionally exposed image loss and canonical identity changes during history reconstruction. The app's replica cache serializes only the text and incorrectly considers remote image messages lossless, so refreshing can remove an image even after live delivery works.

This patch carries optional image bytes through canonical submission, OMP native replay, the wire schema, client reducers, plugin projection, and the existing thumbnail/lightbox UI. The local replica stores the portable images along with the timeline row. Pi history replay now preserves native images and explicitly persisted message identity associations.

### Goals

- An independent client receives a submitted image without relying on the sender's local file, blob URL, or attachment store.
- Image-only and text-plus-image messages remain visible after reload.
- Preserve prompt identity and avoid duplicating the sender's optimistic row.
- OMP native live events and imported history retain image blocks.
- Pi native history retains image-only and text-plus-image messages, with canonical IDs restored when an explicit association was persisted.
- Keep older text-only wire messages valid; older clients can still parse the existing user-message shape.

### Non-goals

- Retrofitting native history import formats beyond OMP and Pi.
- Recovering image bytes from old canonical rows that never stored them.
- Changing image upload, model input capabilities, or lightbox design.

### QA

Final head `bd3bbb45f` contains production repair `516f41b4f` plus a fixture-only typing follow-up. The three production blobs are identical between those commits. Pi native image-only and text-plus-image history now preserve original image blocks. Explicit native-entry/client-message associations are stored in the existing Pi persistence handle; the manager restores canonical wire IDs and retains native rewind targets. Legacy handles without a recorded association keep native IDs; no content-based identity guessing is added.

- Production repair: 345 tests pass across the three affected suites, including captured native Pi data and real AgentStorage disk reload, prime/forced history, refresh and rewind. Owning build, repository format/typecheck/lint and complete serial hooks pass.
- Fixture-only follow-up: both affected Pi suites pass 135 tests; compiler-checked fixtures replace three assertions without changing captured data. Format/typecheck/lint and complete serial hooks pass. These tests overlap the earlier 345 and are not additive.
- Real installed Pi1.3.0 with configured `google-cloud/gemini-3.8-flash`: all 29 QA checks pass. Two independent clients and the actual Chromium app preserve image bytes, canonical IDs, order, previews and lightboxes after provider refresh, browser reload and isolated daemon disk restart. Browser assertions wait for the current canonical epoch and for Updating messages to clear. Two new image prompts were sent, four total across old/new QA; no automatic retry or additional inference was used for the typing follow-up.

[Fixed Pi runtime, screenshots, source hashes and validation logs](https://github.com/RoundRedDot/paseo/tree/dcf47cd097e267715c4c0e114a83f025fda399e0/6736-pi-fixed). Runtime ran on the repaired tree before the production commit; recorded file hashes match `516f41b4f`. It was not rerun after the fixture-only commit. The [original 17-pass/4-fail Pi capture](https://github.com/RoundRedDot/paseo/tree/dcf47cd097e267715c4c0e114a83f025fda399e0/6736-pi-before) remains intact and is not counted as passing evidence. The configured provider/model identifier is recorded by Pi; its existing extension's upstream routing was not independently audited.

OMP18.11.3 startup remains blocked by missing default model/auth configuration, with zero inference requests. [Original blocker and provenance](https://github.com/RoundRedDot/paseo/tree/dcf47cd097e267715c4c0e114a83f025fda399e0/6736-omp-blocker). Earlier OMP typed-adapter and mock-provider browser checks remain fixture evidence. Real OMP mapping and native iOS/Android/Electron acceptance remain unverified; this PR stays Draft. No production daemon restart or deployment.

### Checklist

- [x] Plugin changes follow the SDK import boundaries (host projection only; no new plugin client imports)
- [x] One focused change
- [x] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [x] `npm run lint` passes for changed files
- [x] Formatting passes using `format:files` and the staged-file hook
- [ ] QA evidence complete on native devices and a real OMP runtime
- [x] Tests added or updated where it made sense
title: fix: preserve image messages across clients and reloads
